newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices fall, boosting demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices fall, boosting demand.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume jumped to 1,332 kilos on Thursday from Wednesday's 935 kilos as lower prices drove up demand, dealers said.
Gold prices dipped to $340.05 an ounce and 1,600,000 lira per gram from $342.65 and 1,605,900 lira on Wednesday in line with lower levels on European markets.
The Turkish currency closed at 145,900 lira to the dollar, weaker than Wednesday's 145,500 but firmer than a day's low of 145,990 due to late central bank intervention to support the lira.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,047 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 68.5 percent of trade conducted in lira terms.
